headline: Verbruggen's clean sheet keeps test31 dry
deck: test31 beats test31121 34-31, Verbruggen's eight and Belloumi's nine decisive
body:
Two nines split this tie down the middle, and it was the man behind them who tipped it. Verbruggen's clean sheet and eight points gave test31 a base test31121 could not match, and Belloumi's nine up top matched Kostoulas blow for blow. Mykolenko's six from the back did the rest of the settling.

test31121 will point at the top of the sheet and rightly so: Kostoulas returned nine, the equal of anything test31 had. But behind him the picture thinned fast. Ampadu and Gabriel managed five apiece and the midfield trio of Berge, Ødegaard and Szoboszlai returned three each, and three points from a midfielder is not the return a captaincy expects.

The margin was three, which is exactly the gap between test31's goalkeeper and test31121's not having one that scored. Belloumi and Kostoulas cancelled; Verbruggen did not. That is the tie.
